name: KUA Kecamatan Banjarbaru Utara – bimbingan perkawinan (catin) & konsultasi keluarga
address: Jl. Melati, Komet, Banjarbaru Utara 70714 (Google/Exa) — conflicting sources: an indozone 2026 guide says Jl. Karang Anyar

hours.office: Mon–Thu 07.30–16.00, Fri 07.30–16.30 WITA, Sat–Sun closed (Exa/Google); indozone gives 08.00 start

services: konsultasi keluarga sakinah / masalah rumah tangga
cost: bimwin free (Kemenag national); KUA consultation not priced in sources
eligibility: residents of Banjarbaru Utara (catin, married couples)
local_notes: Reviews (2021–2025) mention a small office near a school, with clear guidance on online registration. There are 5 KUA in Banjarbaru (Utara, Selatan, Landasan Ulin, Liang Anggang, Cempaka); only this one has been pinned. A Banjarbaru-specific BP4 counselling unit was NOT verified.

field_confidence.bimwin_free: single source (national Kemenag source, not Banjarbaru-specific)

sources.note: guide Feb 2026: 5 KUA, hours, services (low-quality aggregate)

validation_note: Location comes from the Google pin with an address conflict. Counselling services are described generically, so treat them as single source.
